blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Bettors can get a shot at the over half-a-billion-peso jackpot in tonight’s Ultra Lotto 6/58 draw. According to the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO), the estimated 6/58 jackpot for the November 10, 2026, 9 p.m. draw is P511 million. During last Sunday’s draw, the PCSO described the P500-million jackpot as the biggest initial jackpot prize for the Ultra Lotto. READ: Lotto results for Nov. 9, 2026 No one picked the correct number combination in the November 8 Ultra Lotto 6/58 draw (22-14-01-42-09-08), which carried a jackpot prize of P500,614,204.72.
